findings.text: None of the brief's required proof shots exist. The brief asks for shots of the open ☰ drawer's header strip and agent chips (at 1920 and 400), the composer panel, the tab row at one line, and the "+ New session" button on `/framework/ai/`. The only shots given (`shots/127-0-0-1-50231-framework-ext-drawer/`) are of the drawer's existing doc page with the drawer **closed** — the feature this task built is not visible in any shot.

`layout.json`'s `tab_rows` (2 at 400, 1 at 1200/1920/3440) measures the doc page's own Overview/Docs/Files tab strip, not the drawer's AI/Dictation/Settings row the brief asks to fit on one line at the drawer's 19rem width — so ask 4 has no real measurement behind it, only source reading.
The brief asks to check the composer's new colours "in light and dark." No dark-mode shot was taken to check against.

answer.reply: fixed: the new composer (Widget.js) is now a SIBLING of the feed card, not a child padded inside it — a new `.ux-dictate-widget-shell` wraps both. The card's bottom border/radius are squared off (Widget.css), the composer runs the shell's full width with its own background, a top border as the seam, and a side/bottom border + bottom radius that pick up where the card's own border stops, so the two read as one shape, never a box inside a box. Found and fixed one more thing while measuring it: the composer's own wrapper carried v1's old `padding-block-end: 0.3em`, which left a 5px gap below it — scoped that rule to v1 only (`:has(.ux-dictate-widget-input)`). Checked and confirmed flush (0px gap, same width, same left edge) in all three: public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/minion-drawer-chat/shots/box-fix-1920.png, box-fix-400.png, box-fix-1920-dark.png. Also re-checked the other 3 surfaces this touches, since Widget.js changed: the standalone Dictate page demo (dictate-overview-1200-round2.png), the ai2 card sidebar, which strips ALL of the card's and composer's extra borders on purpose ('one frame, not two') — updated ux/Card/Card.css to strip the composer's new borders too, confirmed clean (card-sidebar-1920.png) — and the mobile ✦ sheet (mobile-sheet-400.png, zero console errors).

fixed: ext/drawer/doc/tabs.md was the real gap — never touched in round 1, still said 'five tabs' including Sessions and Admin, and `?drawer=sessions` with no mention of the AI-tab remap. Rewrote its tab table and the route-word section to the current three (AI, Dictation, Settings) plus Element, explained AI's header strip as the old Sessions tab folded in, and Admin as a Settings section. Also fixed two smaller stale spots found while checking: `doc/file/tabs.js.md` ('the five tabs' -> the real list) and `menu.js`'s own ☰ tooltip ('AI, sessions, dictation, settings' -> 'AI, dictation, settings'). ext/drawer/page.js and readme.md were already fixed in round 1 and still read true. The walkthrough (`walkthrough/page.js`) still shows old screenshots of the pre-merge Sessions tab and an old AI tab with a model picker — NOT fixed this round (it needs new screenshots, not just text, and wasn't named in this review), logged as a follow-up below.

fixed: public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/minion-drawer-chat/shots/switcher-1920.png and switcher-400.png show the switcher open with 3 stubbed sessions (the live one marked with a dot, the other two with 'N hours/days ago'). Found and fixed a layout bug while building this shot: the switch-list was nested INSIDE the button row (`.drawer-ai-switcher`, a flex row), so it sat wedged between '+ New session' and 'Switch session' instead of dropping below them — moved it to be the row's own sibling instead (tabs/ai.js). The drawer's own tab row, measured at its CSS default width (19rem, no drag — a fresh browser profile has no --drawer-w saved): drawer width 304px (= 19rem at the 16px root), tab row height 28px, one line, 4 tabs (AI, Dictation, Settings, Files). Measured the same way at 400px too (where the drawer becomes the whole sheet, per readme.md): row height 25px, still one line.
